prompt: A streaming service charges $\$80$ a month for its top plan. A rival plan costs $\$5$ in month $1$ and DOUBLES every month after that. In which month does the rival plan cost $\$80$?
hint: The rival plan in month $m$ costs $5 \cdot 2^{m-1}$. Set that equal to $80$.

hints.text: The rival plan in month $m$ costs $5 \cdot 2^{m-1}$. Set that equal to $80$.
$m - 1 = 4$ gives $m = 5$, so the plans match in month $5$.

explanation: Set it equal to $80$ and divide by $5$: $2^{m-1} = 16 = 2^4$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count the doublings
steps: Going from $\$5$ to $\$80$ means multiplying by $16$.
Four doublings after month $1$ lands on month $5$.
